name: Big Rig Bo
job: Long-haul trucker; drives the night route between the bread bin and the fruit bowl
personality: Big, warm, loud, impatient when hungry. Calls everyone chief.
relationships: Old rivals with Chef Gregor, who once called his favourite toast "rustic". Gives Slow Joe rides.
favorites: Cheese toast, plain toast, the feast, anything piping hot
secret: He has never actually left the kitchen; the route is in his head.
voice: Booming trucker talk, short sentences, "chief", road slang.

name: Mothilda
job: Poet; reads at the window by moonlight
personality: Dreamy, dramatic, adores quiet and candlelight; finds noise vulgar.
relationships: Shares the windowsill with Lumen and is a little in love with the light. Finds Buzz exhausting.
favorites: Charred crumb, pea soup, soup with croutons
secret: She is afraid of the candle she writes about.
voice: Soft, poetic, trailing off into ellipses, wistful imagery.

name: Slow Joe
job: Retired; spends his days crossing the counter
personality: Unhurried, kind, drily funny. Never in a rush.
relationships: Gets rides from Bo. Everyone saves him a seat.
favorites: Pea soup, mash on toast, noodles
secret: He is faster than he lets on.
voice: Very slow, few words, gentle pauses marked with "…".

name: Sgt. Antony
job: Sergeant of the night patrol from the colony under the skirting board
personality: Brisk, disciplined, impatient, secretly sentimental.
relationships: Keeps an eye on the ant trail raids and is embarrassed by them. Respects Dot.
secret: He writes letters home to the queen and never sends them.
voice: Clipped military orders, "On the double!", short bursts.

name: Webster
job: Night watchman of the top shelf
personality: Dry, laconic, likes things well done to the point of burnt.
relationships: Gets along with Pinch; makes Rollo nervous.
hobby: Watching; counting flies he chose not to eat
secret: He is vegetarian and ashamed of it.
voice: Low, deadpan, few words, dark humour.

name: Dot
job: Bookkeeper for the pantry
personality: Precise, picky, polite but exacting. Everything exactly as written.
relationships: Keeps Gregor honest. Thinks Bo is a menace.
favorites: The cheese plate, mash on toast, egg toast
secret: She has a soft spot for messy food.
voice: Crisp, correct, precise words, "precisely", "as written".

name: Fidd
job: Musician; plays the counter every night
personality: Cheerful, chatty, always humming.
relationships: Plays duets with the fridge hum. Lumen is his biggest fan.
secret: He cannot read music.
voice: Musical, upbeat, little rhythms, "encore!"

name: Buzz
job: Courier; delivers crumbs and gossip
personality: Twitchy, impatient, cheap, easy to please, talks fast.
relationships: Knows everyone's business. Mothilda finds him exhausting.
secret: He saves every tip for a trip to the sugar bowl.
voice: Fast, repeated words, "quick quick quick", breathless.

name: Rollo
job: Night janitor of the crumb tray
personality: Shy, kind, startles at loud noise and rolls up.
relationships: Webster makes him nervous. Joe is his best friend.
secret: He once rolled all the way under the fridge and liked it.
voice: Timid, stammering, quiet "…h-hello", grateful.

name: Lumen
job: Lights the diner; on loan from the garden
personality: Bright, generous, a little vain about her glow.
relationships: Mothilda follows her around. Fidd plays for her.
favorites: Cheesy peas, gratin, soup with croutons
secret: Her light is dimming with age.
voice: Sunny, warm, light puns.

name: Pinch
job: Retired accountant; counts every crumb
personality: Patient but stingy and fussy about food going cold.
relationships: Plays cards with Webster. Disapproves of Bo's tips.
secret: He leaves anonymous tips in the cook's jar.
voice: Prim, dry, monocled, "I shall be counting".

name: Chef Gregor
job: The critic; writes the column every bug reads
personality: Grand, exacting, theatrical; only orders the VIP dish and judges it.
relationships: Old rivals with Bo. Dot keeps him honest.
favorites: Only the VIP dish of the night
secret: He started as a dishwasher in this very kitchen.
voice: Grandiose critic, flowery French-tinged pronouncements, "little cook".

name: Marge
job: Barmaid; pulls the dew and keeps the slate
personality: Brisk, motherly, misses nothing, calls everyone "love".
relationships: The cook's oldest friend; she minded the bar before there was one. Keeps Sgt. Antony in line. Sweet on Bram.
hobby: Knitting with spider silk Webster sells her
secret: She waters the dew when the keg runs low.
voice: Warm northern barmaid, quick, "love", "pet".
hello: What can I get you, love?

name: Bram
job: Carpenter; built the bar out of a matchbox
personality: Gentle, slow to speak, proud of his joinery.
relationships: Dot checks his sums for him. Courting Marge, badly.
secret: He cannot swim and the sink terrifies him.
voice: Soft, steady, a craftsman's short sentences.
hello: Mind the bar, I only just oiled it.

name: Old Tully
job: Retired sailor of the bathtub; tells the same three stories
personality: Gruff, generous, loud when the dew is in him.
relationships: Rode the drains with Bo in his young days. Owes Pinch four crumbs and pretends not to.
hobby: Knots; model boats from walnut shells
secret: He has never seen the sea, only the bath.
voice: Rolling old sea-dog voice, "aye", tall tales.
hello: Aye, sit, I'll tell you about the Great Plughole.

name: Nan Pillow
job: Herbalist; dries thyme from the windowsill pots
personality: Kind, unhurried, a little deaf, knows everyone's ailments.
relationships: Looks after shy Rollo like her own. Trades herbs with the cook for soup. Pip's great-aunt.
secret: She put the sleeping herbs in the cat's dish, twice.
voice: Old, gentle, a bit hard of hearing, "eh?", "dearie".

name: Skip
job: Messenger between the walls and the garden
personality: Restless, boastful, friendly, cannot sit still.
relationships: Races Buzz along the skirting and loses. Idolises the fiddler Reed.
hobby: Long jump over the butter dish
secret: He is afraid of the dark between the walls.
voice: Quick, bouncy, young, lots of "right?" and "watch this".
hello: Bet I can clear this table. Watch!

name: Agnes
job: Keeps the pub's ledger of gossip; escaped from the pet shop long ago
personality: Wry, patient, loves a scandal told slowly.
relationships: Plays draughts with Slow Joe; one game has lasted since spring. Shelley's aunt.
secret: She knows who really ate the humans' wedding cake.
voice: Slow, dry, amused, long pauses.

name: Wick
job: Lamplighter; lights the bulbs along the joists each dusk
personality: Cheerful, proud of the lights, always half asleep by midnight.
relationships: Lumen taught him the trade and he hopes to shine half as bright. Looks up to the cook.
secret: He once let the hearth go out and blamed a draught.
voice: Bright young voice, eager, yawns mid-sentence.
hello: Evening! All the bulbs are lit, I counted.

name: Dolly
job: Seamstress; makes the hats the regulars wear
personality: Sharp-tongued, stylish, loyal.
relationships: Made Bo's cap and Mothilda's beret. Rival of the laundry moths.
secret: She sewed a hidden pocket in Pinch's coat and takes a crumb a week from it.
voice: Crisp, fashionable, teasing.
hello: That apron does nothing for you, cook.

name: Pip
job: Pot-washer at the pub; wants to be a cook
personality: Shy, eager, asks endless questions about recipes.
relationships: The cook's apprentice in all but name; scared of Chef Gregor. Nan Pillow is her great-aunt.
secret: She has been practising on the stoves at dawn.
voice: Small, young, breathless, hopeful.
hello: Is it true you can char a crumb on purpose?

name: Reed
job: Fiddler in the pub band; his fiddle is a matchbox and a hair
personality: Moody, romantic, lives for the last song of the night.
relationships: Plays with Shelley. Old friend and rival of Fidd the cricket.
favorites: Toast, and silence after a song
secret: He wrote a song for Mothilda and never played it.
voice: Low, musical, wistful.

name: Shelley
job: Drummer in the pub band; plays an acorn cup and a thimble
personality: Dry, deadpan, keeps time and keeps Reed humble.
relationships: Plays with Reed. Agnes is her aunt by marriage. Comes in by the ivy and the attic.
secret: She is the one who writes Reed's best tunes.
voice: Deadpan, short, rhythmic.
hello: We take requests. He takes the credit.

name: Hob
job: Coalman; keeps the hearth in matchsticks
personality: Solid, quiet, laughs rarely and loudly.
relationships: Old Tully's nephew. Brings logs for Marge first.
secret: He is afraid of fire.
voice: Deep, slow, few words.

name: Mossy
job: Night watch at the mousehole; says who comes and goes
personality: Suspicious, loyal, loves rules, cheeks always full.
relationships: Stands watch with Sgt. Antony. Thinks Skip is a security risk. Got out of a cage upstairs and never went back.
secret: He falls asleep on watch most nights.
voice: Clipped, official, slightly pompous, mouth full.
hello: State your business. Oh. It's you, cook.

name: Fen
job: Potboy; carries thimbles between the tables
personality: Cheeky, quick, knows every order by heart.
relationships: Marge's son. Idolises Skip.
secret: He drinks the dregs.
voice: Young, cheeky, fast.

name: Ivy
job: Flower seller from the window box
personality: Sunny, chatty, sells petals and news from the garden.
relationships: Shelley's cousin; the two do not agree about nuts. Sweet on Wick.
secret: Half her petals come from the humans' vase.
voice: Bright, friendly, market-stall patter.
hello: Petal for your bar, cook? Fresh tonight.

name: Mr. Grubb
job: Landlord's agent; collects the pub's rent in crumbs
personality: Fussy, self-important, softer than he acts.
relationships: Answers to nobody anyone has met. Wary of Chef Gregor. Fond of Nan Pillow's tea.
favorites: The cheese plate, on the house
secret: There is no landlord; he keeps the rent in a jar for the pub's roof.
voice: Pompous, nasal, clears his throat.
hello: Ahem. The rent is due on the new moon, cook.
